channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: ‘Difficult to change a regime from the air’ – former CIA analyst
item.description: We spoke to Ken Pollack, a former Gulf military analyst at the CIA, who served on the US National Security Council and is now Vice President for Policy at the Middle East Institute.

item.title: ‘This is called self-defence’, says former Israeli PM on Iran strikes
item.description: It was Israel that first confirmed bombing was underway early this morning, when it announced what it called a 'pre-emptive attack' on Iran.

item.title: US-Israeli strikes ‘undoubtedly an illegal aggression’ – former British Ambassador to Iran
item.description: We spoke to former British Ambassador to Iran, Richard Dalton.

item.title: How a decades-long feud led to US-Israeli strikes on Iran
item.description: The joint American-Israeli strikes in Iran may have been precipitated by a staggering build up of force in the region, but its roots go back more than just a few weeks.

item.title: US attacks ‘most serious threat regime has ever faced’ – director of Crisis Group’s Iran Project
item.description: Ali Vaez, director of Crisis Group's Iran Project joins us now from Geneva, where talks between Iran and the US had been taking place.

item.title: Khamenei dead: What next for Iran and the Middle East?
item.description: There was no shortage of bombast from Donald Trump on the second day of his war with Iran.

item.title: Regime is ‘lashing out indiscriminately’ – Iran expert
item.description: We spoke to an Iran expert, Professor Ali Ansari.

item.title: Iranians in the UK react to death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei
item.description: Iranians living in the UK have welcomed the blow to the regime, many of them fled as dissidents.

item.title: ‘We could very easily come under attack from the Iranians’ – former British special advisor
item.description: The new conflict in the Middle East comes just months after Donald Trump claimed to have obliterated Iran's nuclear programme.

item.title: How long will Trump push on with Operation Epic Fury?
item.description: A day and a half after the launch of Operation Epic Fury, with the death of three US service personnel announced this afternoon will President Trump, who said the campaign was “going very well”, keep his nerve and continue to order the American military to hit Iran with his promised “unprecedented force”?
